tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs bzhugs/

༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra bi dā ra nā ma dha ra ṇi/ bod skad du/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje la rab tu bzhugs te/ sangs rgyas kyi mthus lag na rdo rje'i lus thams cad rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs nas/ rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so// de nas lag na rdo rje sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyis brlabs dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs kyis rdo rje khro bo las byung ba rdo rje'i dam tshig smras te/ mi chod pa/ mi shigs pa/ bden pa/ sra ba/ brtan pa/ thams cad du thogs pa med pa/ thams cad du ma pham pa/ sems can thams cad skrag par byed pa/ sems can thams cad 'jigs par byed pa/ rig sngags thams cad gcod par byed pa/ rig sngags thams cad gnon par byed pa/ las thams cad 'joms par byed pa/ gzhan gyi las thams cad 'jig par byed pa/ gdon thams cad brlag par byed pa/ gdon thams cad las rnam par thar bar byed pa// 'byung po thams cad 'gug par byed pa/ rig sngags kyi las thams cad byed du 'jug pa/ ma grub pa rnams grub par byed pa/ grub pa rnams chud mi za bar byed pa/ 'dod pa thams cad rab tu sbyin pa/ sems can thams cad srung ba/ zhi ba rgyas pa/ sems can thams cad skrag par byed pa/ sems can thams cad rmugs par byed pa/ sems can thams cad rmongs par byed pa'i gsang sngags kyi tshig chen po 'di sangs rgyas kyi mthus lag na rdo rjes rab tu smras so// na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma sh+tsan+ḍa badz+ra yā ṇa ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se ṇā pa ta ye/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ tru ṭa tru ṭa/ tro ṭa ya tro ṭa ya/ s+phu ṭa s+phu ṭa/ s+pho ṭā ya s+pho ṭa ya/ ghurna ghurna/ ghurna pa ya ghurna pa ya/ sarba sa twa naṃ/ bo dha bo dha/ saṃ bo dha ya saṃ po dha ya/

tra sa tra sa/ trā sa ya trā sa ya/ bha ma bha ma/ saṃ bha ma ya saṃ bha mā ya/ sarba bhu tā ni/ ku ṭa ku ṭa/ saṃ ku ṭa ya saṃ ku ṭa ya/ sarba sha trun+nāṃ/ gha ṭa gha ṭa/ saṃ gha ṭā ya saṃ gha ṭa ya/ sarba bid+yaṃ badz+ra badz+ra/ s+pho ṭā ya badz+ra badz+ra/ ka ṭa ya badz+ra badz+ra/ ma ṭa badz+ra badz+ra/ ma tha badz+ra badz+ra/ badz+ra aṭ+ṭa sa ha nī la badz+ra/ su badz+ra ya swā hā/ he phu lu ni ru phu lu ni gri h+na ku lu/ mi li/ tsu lu/ ghu nu/ phul lu/ ku ru ku lu/ badz+ra bi dzā ya swā hā/ ki li kī lā ya swā hā/ ka ṭa ka ṭa/ ma ṭa ma ṭa/ ra ṭa ra ṭa/ mo tra na pra mo ṭa na ya swā hā/ tsa ra ṇi sh+tsa ra/ ha ra ha ra/ sa ra sa ra/ mā ra ya/ badz+ra bi dā ra ṇā ya swā hā/ tshin+dha tshin+dha/ bhin+dha bhin+dha/ ma hā badz+ra kī li kī lā ya swā hā/ ban+dha ban+dha/ kro dha kro dha/ ma hā badz+ra kī li kī lā ya swā hā/ tsu ru tsu ru/ tsan+ḍa kī li kī lā ya swā hā/ trā sa ya trā sa ya/ ma hā badz+ra kī li kī lā ya swā hā/ ha ra ha ra/ badz+ra dha rā ya swā hā/ pra ha ra pra ha ra/ badz+ra pra bhañtsa nā ya swā hā/ ma ti s+thi ra badz+ra/ shru ti s+thi ra badz+ra/ pra ti s+thi ra badz+ra/ ma hā badz+ra/ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra/ a mo gha badz+ra/ e h+ye hi/ shī gh+raṃ badz+ra dhā ra ye swā hā/ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ sarba badz+ra ku laṃ ā warta ya swā hā/ sarba bigh+nan shra tūn mā ra ya phaṭa/ na maḥs man+ta badz+ra ṇaṃ/ sarba ba laṃ ā warta ya/ ma hā ba le ka ṭa we/ ta ta le/ a tsa le/ man+ḍa le ma ye/ a ti badz+ra/ ma hā ba la be ga ra ṇa ra ṇa/ a dzi te/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ ti ṭi ti ṭi/ biṅga la/ da ha da ha/ te dzo wa ti/ ti li ti li/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ma hā ba le/ sarba badz+ra aṃ ku shwa dz+wa lā ya swā hā/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mash+tsan+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se na pa ta ye/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ ha ra ha ra badz+ra/ ma tha ma tha badz+ra/ dhu na dha na badz+ra/ ha na ha na badz+ra/ da ha da ha badz+ra/ pa tsa pa tsa badz+ra/ dha ra dha ra badz+ra/ dhā ra ya dhā ra ya badz+ra/ dā ru ṇa dā ru ṇa badz+ra/

tshin+dha tshin+dha badz+ra/ bhin+dha bhin+dha badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ na ma sh+tsan+ḍa badz+ra kro dha ya/ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭhātiṣ+ṭha/ bhan+dha bhan+dha/ ha na ha na/ a mri te hūṃ phaṭa/ sdig pa thams cad byang byas nas// sdug bsngal thams cad med par byed// rgyud do cog gi rtsa ba ste// dpal kun gyis ni legs par brgyan// sems can dbang po nyams pa dang*// tshe zad pa dang tshe nyams dang*// phun sum tshogs min gang chags dang*// lha rnams rgyab kyis phyogs pa dang*// mdza' sdug skye bo sdang ba dang*// bran bza' la sogs gtses pa dang*// phan tshun mthun pa ma yin dang*/ nor 'grib pas ni gnod pa dang*// mya ngan ngal dang gnod pa dang*// 'jigs pa dang ni phongs pa dang*// gza' dang rgyu skar byed stems dang*// mi bzad gdon gyis nyen pa dang*// mya ngan ngal las byung ba yi// rmi lam sdig pa mthong na yang*// de ni rab bkrus gtsang ma yis/ mdo sde dam pa mnyan par bya// gang dag yid dge sems dang zhing*// gtsang ma'i gos kyis rab brgyan te// zab mo sangs rgyas spyod yul ba// mdo sde 'di ni nyan byed na// mdo sde 'di yi gzi brjid kyis// srog chags dag ni thams cad kyi// mi bzad pa yi nad rnams kyang*// de dag thams cad zhi bar blta// tshe dang bsod nams rnam par 'phel/ sdig pa kun las rnam par thar/ nor bu yungs kar durba dang*// rin chen rma med tsan dan bcas// shel dang rdo rje mu tig dang*// chu yis gser ram yang na ni// dngul gyi bum pa dag kyang rung*// gtsang ma'i gos kyis dkris shing dag /lan grangs nyi shu rtsa gcig gam// yang na lan grangs brgya rtsa brgyad// rdo rje rnam 'joms bzlas nas ni// rgyal po ltar du khrus gyis shig /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' bstsal nas/ phyag na rdo rjes de skad ces gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// gzungs mdo 'di ni rdo rje 'chang chen po rje btsun tā ra nā thas zhus dag gnang ba'i dpe las bris pa'o/// /bkra shis// shu bhaṃ/// /
